steps.action: Open Purchasing → Purchase Orders and click 'New Order'
steps.description: From the main navigation, open the Purchasing module, choose Purchase Orders, then click the 'New Order' button.
steps.expectedResult: A blank 'New Purchase Order' form opens.

steps.description: Click the Supplier field, type 'North', and pick 'Northwind Office Supply (V-10482)'.
steps.expectedResult: Payment Terms and Ship-to Address default from the supplier record.

steps.action: Add a line: 'A4 copy paper, 80 gsm', quantity 20, unit price 34.50
steps.description: Click 'Add line', choose the item, enter the quantity and unit price, then press Tab.
Scroll to the bottom of the form and click 'Submit for approval'.
